summary: Iteration 36 — Teacher attendance + Absentees panel. Backend: 14/14 pytest tests passed (auth/RBAC, 4 statuses, idempotent upsert, today roster + counts, role-scoped list, day/week/month aggregation incl. attendance percentage, class+section filter). Iter35 regression still 25/25 green. Frontend: 3 AttendancePage tabs render, period toggle (day/week/month) works, KPI tiles populate, teacher status pills (present/absent/leave/half_day) clickable, Save persists, Absent-today strip appears. TimetablePage colors picked-day cells: marked teacher row shows ABSENT/PRESENT tints with a 'picked' ring on the row; unpicked days remain neutral. Test data restored (all teachers back to 'present').

issues: Date input uses the browser-native HTML5 date picker (input[type=date]) instead of the shadcn Calendar component used elsewhere — minor UX inconsistency.

critical_code_review_comments: teacher_attendance.py upsert is fine, but there is no unique index on (school_id, teacher_id, date) shown in this file — confirm core/db.py declares it (request says it does) to guarantee one-row-per-day under race conditions.
absentees endpoint loops in Python over up to 20k attendance rows; for large schools/long months consider a Mongo aggregation pipeline. OK at current scale.

TimetablePage does GET /users?role=teacher which is open to school_admin only — teachers/parents viewing this page would error. Confirm route is school_admin-only (it appears to be in /school/* layout, so fine).

seed_data_creation: None. Tests use existing DEMO seed. Cleanup test sets every teacher back to 'present' for today so no stale absent state remains.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login uses COOKIE auth (POST /api/auth/login with body {email,password}); response is the user object, not a token. Use requests.Session() and reuse it for subsequent calls. The login email input on the UI has placeholder containing 'principal' — selector input[type="email"] does NOT match. Use input[placeholder*="principal"] or a more specific selector. AttendancePage tab data-testids: attendance-tab-mark / -absentees / -teachers. Period buttons: absentees-period-day / -week / -month. Teacher status pills: teacher-att-{teacher_id}-{status}. Timetable cells: tt-cell-{day}-{period} with data-status attribute (only set for picked day's row).
